subject: Shared KB lesson validation
object: revealing file paths, email addresses, and secret-looking tokens in lesson text, so a lesson is sanitized before it is queued to the outbox or contributed to cq

subject: Shared KB contribution
object: local-only mode so Barry does not send shared KB contributions unless the user explicitly opts in

subject: Shared KB contribution mode
object: .barry-cache/config.json as repo-local user config with local_only, preview_only, or share_enabled values

subject: barry-cache kb sharing
object: shared KB contribution status and set commands using local-only, preview-only, and share-enabled CLI mode names

subject: barry-cache kb propose
object: lesson proposal creation on preview-only or share-enabled mode, queuing the validated lesson to the repo-local outbox for later contribution

subject: barry-cache kb harvest
object: a candidate lesson, a value gate, and a sanitization checklist from the latest finalize handoff or validation failure, leaving abstraction and confirmation to the agent via kb propose (agent-in-the-loop, no LLM in Barry)

subject: Shared KB harvest
object: preview-only or share-enabled mode, and a successful finalize nudges the agent to run kb harvest only when sharing is enabled

subject: barry-cache kb harvest --source context
object: the existing context backlog (active decision facts, active ADRs, recorded validation failures) into sanitization candidates, excluding implemented/test facts, superseded records, and src file pointers, then flows through the agent-in-the-loop propose path

subject: Existing Barry context
object: abstracted, sanitized lessons via filtered agent-in-the-loop harvest, never as a raw dump of canonical facts, because canonical context is project-specific and source-backed

subject: barry-cache kb propose
object: the lesson, anti_pattern, and decision_pattern kinds via --kind so harvested decisions and failures keep their taxonomy

subject: Barry shared KB direction
object: interoperate with Mozilla cq as a provenance-annotated contributor (REST propose) and consumer (search) through a versioned adapter mapping Barry lessons to cq's authoritative schema, retire the standalone global Brain, signed-snapshot distribution, and self-validation/reputation engine entirely (no research fork), and keep Barry's lesson format canonical with Ed25519 signing retained for local integrity only because cq cannot carry signatures or rich attestations

subject: barry-cache kb search --source cq
object: a configured cq endpoint via GET /api/v1/knowledge through a versioned adapter (CQ_SCHEMA_VERSION), sending a required domains filter (--domains or shared_kb.cq.domains) as the cq query parameter, then mapping cq knowledge_units to Barry search items and scoring them by the free-text query locally; gated on share-enabled mode and erroring clearly on a non-JSON response

subject: cq endpoint descriptor
object: .barry-cache/config.json as shared_kb.cq with url, optional api_key_ref (env:NAME), and optional domains, and is preserved when the contribution mode is rewritten

subject: barry-cache kb contribute
object: each queued outbox lesson to cq POST /api/v1/knowledge as a propose request (domains<-tags, insight summary/detail/action, provenance prose appended to detail, created_by=validator id, context.pattern from applies/avoid_when), gated on share-enabled, with --dry-run; cq propose carries no signature or evidence so signing stays local

subject: barry-cache kb cq login
object: the cq API key in a git-ignored owner-only .barry-cache/cq-credentials.json (separate from config.json), records the cq endpoint (default https://api.cq.exchange — the hosted REST API; cq.exchange itself is the web UI — with --url to override), and enables share-enabled; the key is read from --api-key, CQ_API_KEY, or stdin; resolution prefers an api_key_ref env over the stored key; kb cq logout removes the key and sets local-only
